info.description: The Carrental Reservations Insurance Retrieval API provides access to insurance details associated with car rental reservations. Users can efficiently retrieve insurance information to ensure proper coverage during their rental periods. This API is particularly useful for rental agents, insurance providers, and customers looking to verify or update their insurance details. By integrating this API, partners can streamline the insurance verification process, leading to improved customer satisfaction and reduced operational overhead.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch insurance information associated with reservations. Use this to check coverage details, costs, and terms of insurance for specific bookings.
